library(readxl)
p <- "inputs/differential-results-333333333333.xlsx"
sh <- excel_sheets(p); print(sh)
for (s in sh) { d <- read_excel(p, sheet=s, n_max=5); cat("\n==",s,"dim-preview\n"); print(names(d)); print(as.data.frame(d)) }

x <- read.csv("inputs/expression-matrix-444444444444.csv", check.names=FALSE, skip=1)
cat(dim(x)[1], dim(x)[2], "\n"); print(names(x)); print(x[1:3,1:5])

suppressMessages({library(ggplot2);library(ggrepel)})
x <- read.csv("inputs/expression-matrix-444444444444.csv", check.names=FALSE, skip=1)
m <- aggregate(x[,-1], by=list(id=x$id), FUN=mean); rownames(m)<-m$id; M<-as.matrix(m[,-1])
cohort_a_c<-1:3; cohort_a_s<-4:6; cohort_b_c<-7:9; cohort_b_s<-10:12
tt <- function(a,b){ apply(M,1,function(v){ o<-try(t.test(v[b],v[a]),silent=TRUE); if(inherits(o,"try-error")) 1 else o$p.value}) }
res <- data.frame(id=rownames(M),
  lfc_cohort_a = rowMeans(M[,cohort_a_s])-rowMeans(M[,cohort_a_c]),
  lfc_cohort_b = rowMeans(M[,cohort_b_s])-rowMeans(M[,cohort_b_c]),
  p_cohort_a = tt(cohort_a_c,cohort_a_s), p_cohort_b = tt(cohort_b_c,cohort_b_s))
res$fdr_cohort_a<-p.adjust(res$p_cohort_a,"BH"); res$fdr_cohort_b<-p.adjust(res$p_cohort_b,"BH")
cut_l<-1; cut_p<-0.05
sig_cohort_a<-abs(res$lfc_cohort_a)>cut_l & res$p_cohort_a<cut_p
sig_cohort_b<-abs(res$lfc_cohort_b)>cut_l & res$p_cohort_b<cut_p
res$cls<-"Not sig"
res$cls[sig_cohort_a & !sig_cohort_b]<-"CohortA only"
res$cls[!sig_cohort_a & sig_cohort_b]<-"CohortB only"
res$cls[sig_cohort_a & sig_cohort_b & res$lfc_cohort_a*res$lfc_cohort_b>0]<-"Both, same direction"
res$cls[sig_cohort_a & sig_cohort_b & res$lfc_cohort_a*res$lfc_cohort_b<0]<-"Both, opposite"
print(table(res$cls)); write.csv(res,"diagonal_volcano_stats.csv",row.names=FALSE)

suppressMessages({library(ggplot2);library(ggrepel)}) x <- read.csv("inputs/expression-matrix-444444444444.csv", check.names=FALSE, skip=1) m <- aggregate(x[,-1], by=list(id=x$id), FUN=mean); rownames(m)<-m$id; M<-as.matrix(m[,-1]) cohort_a_c<-1:3; cohort_a_s<-4:6; cohort_b_c<-7:9; cohort_b_s<-10:12 tt <- function(a,b) apply(M,1,function(v){o<-try(t.test(v[b],v[a]),silent=TRUE); if(inherits(o,"try-error")) 1 else o$p.value}) d <- data.frame(id=rownames(M), lfc_ctrl=rowMeans(M[,cohort_b_c])-rowMeans(M[,cohort_a_c]), lfc_si =rowMeans(M[,cohort_b_s])-rowMeans(M[,cohort_a_s]), p_ctrl=tt(cohort_a_c,cohort_b_c), p_si=tt(cohort_a_s,cohort_b_s)) d$fdr_ctrl<-p.adjust(d$p_ctrl,"BH"); d$fdr_si<-p.adjust(d$p_si,"BH") L<-1; P<-0.05 sc <- abs(d$lfc_ctrl)>L & d$p_ctrl

L & d$p_si

0]<-"Both, consistent" d$cls[sc&ss&d$lfc_ctrl*d$lfc_si<0]<-"Both, opposite" d$cls<-factor(d$cls,levels=c("Not significant","ctrl only","si only","Both, consistent","Both, opposite")) d$delta<-d$lfc_si-d$lfc_ctrl print(table(d$cls)); write.csv(d,"diagonal_volcano_stats.csv",row.names=FALSE) lab <- rbind(head(d[order(-abs(d$delta)),],12), head(d[order(-(abs(d$lfc_ctrl)+abs(d$lfc_si))),],8)) lab <- lab[!duplicated(lab$id),] cols<-c("Not significant"="grey82","ctrl only"="#4C8BC4","si only"="#E4A33B","Both, consistent"="#C0392B","Both, opposite"="#6B3FA0") lim<-max(abs(c(d$lfc_ctrl,d$lfc_si)))*1.05 p<-ggplot(d,aes(lfc_ctrl,lfc_si,color=cls))+ geom_hline(yintercept=c(-L,L),linetype="dashed",colour="grey60",linewidth=.3)+ geom_vline(xintercept=c(-L,L),linetype="dashed",colour="grey60",linewidth=.3)+ geom_abline(slope=1,intercept=0,colour="grey35",linewidth=.4)+ geom_point(data=subset(d,cls=="Not significant"),size=.7,alpha=.35)+ geom_point(data=subset(d,cls!="Not significant"),size=1.4,alpha=.85)+ geom_text_repel(data=lab,aes(label=id),size=2.8,max.overlaps=Inf,box.padding=.3,segment.size=.25,show.legend=FALSE)+ scale_color_manual(values=cols,name=NULL)+ coord_fixed(xlim=c(-lim,lim),ylim=c(-lim,lim))+ labs(title="Diagonal volcano plot: CohortB vs CohortA under ctrl and si", subtitle=sprintf("|log2FC| > %g & P < %g; diagonal = identical effect in both conditions",L,P), x="log2FC (CohortB_ctrl / CohortA_ctrl)", y="log2FC (CohortB_si / CohortA_si)")+ theme_bw(base_size=11)+theme(panel.grid.minor=element_blank(),legend.position="right", plot.title=element_text(face="bold",size=12)) ggsave("diagonal_volcano.png",p,width=8,height=6.2,dpi=300) ggsave("diagonal_volcano.pdf",p,width=8,height=6.2) "ok"
